task.title: Diagnose: Troubleshoot Firefox import and export failures
task.shortdesc: Diese Prozedur bewahrt Evidence, schützt Benutzerdaten und trennt Operator Action von Product Defect. Diagnose JSON import, multipart import, and Firefox policies export failures while preserving source and exported evidence.

prereq.p: Diese Prozedur bewahrt Evidence, schützt Benutzerdaten und trennt Operator Action von Product Defect. Use this procedure when POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/import/firefox/policies.json or GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/export/profiles/42/firefox/policies.json returns 400, 404, 409, 415, or 422.

context.p: Diese Prozedur bewahrt Evidence, schützt Benutzerdaten und trennt Operator Action von Product Defect. Import/export troubleshooting separates source document validity, multipart field shape, duplicate profile names, archived profile access, and canonical Firefox export from downstream deployment tooling.

step.cmd: Diagnose 1: Identify the operation and content type.

info.p: Diese Prozedur bewahrt Evidence, schützt Benutzerdaten und trennt Operator Action von Product Defect. Record whether the request was JSON FirefoxPoliciesJsonImportRequest, multipart/form-data with file=@policies.json, or export with download=1, pretty=1, or include_deleted=true.

step.cmd: Diagnose 2: Validate the source Firefox document before retrying import.

info.p: Diese Prozedur bewahrt Evidence, schützt Benutzerdaten und trennt Operator Action von Product Defect. Focused rerun: POST $BPM_BASE_URL/api/validate/release-152 with the same document.policies. If validation fails, fix the source document outside BPM before another import.

Diese Prozedur bewahrt Evidence, schützt Benutzerdaten und trennt Operator Action von Product Defect. For 409, choose a new synthetic profile name or archive/restore intentionally. For 415, verify application/json or multipart upload fields. For 422, record field-level errors and do not rewrite profile storage directly.

Diese Prozedur bewahrt Evidence, schützt Benutzerdaten und trennt Operator Action von Product Defect. For 404, re-read GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles/42?include_deleted=true. For archived profiles, decide whether include_deleted=true is appropriate. Compare exported document hash with the reviewed source hash; BPM profile metadata and compliance metadata are not exported.

step.cmd: Diagnose 5: Record recovery and stop conditions.

info.p: Diese Prozedur bewahrt Evidence, schützt Benutzerdaten und trennt Operator Action von Product Defect. Focused rerun: ./.venv/bin/pytest -q -m docs_contract documentation/tests/contract/test_api_integration_topics.py for documented examples.
info.note: Do not retry blindly after mismatched import/export evidence; store source hash, export hash, profile ID, revision, HTTP status, and operator decision.

result.p: Der Operator erhält eine klassifizierte Diagnose, schützt user data und kennt den nächsten smallest rerun. The operator can identify whether the failure belongs to source JSON, multipart fields, profile lifecycle state, or export evidence.

postreq.p: Nach der Behebung zum passenden Administrator/DevOps workflow zurückkehren und nur die betroffenen checks wiederholen. After recovery, attach the evidence to the external control-product audit record.
